title: Affordable Housing Development & Consulting Service
short_description: Consulting and development services for an affordable housing project using LIHTC funding.
project_scope: Development of affordable housing in Normandy, Missouri, utilizing the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) program. The notice indicates professional consulting and development services for housing delivery, with funding sources including LIHTC, CDBG, and HOME. No technical building data such as gross floor area, number of units, height, or structural characteristics are stated.
services: Professional consulting and development services; design-build/developer services related to affordable housing development.
relevance_explanation:
- Residential affordable housing development with no stated structural complexity or special long-span features.
- Focus is on developer/consulting services rather than structural engineering or specialized design.
- No bridge, roof, stadium, special structure, or technically demanding building scope is described.
- Could involve building design indirectly, but the notice provides no indication of an architecturally ambitious or large complex project.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. Available cost-related information: funding sources are LIHTC, CDBG, and HOME, but no unit count, floor area, or project size is provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The procurement is for consulting and development services, but the notice provides no basis for a realistic engineering fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms and individuals to provide professional consulting and development services related to affordable housing utilizing the LIHTC program; disciplines requested include design-build/developer and housing & urban development.
